template.name: Mechanical installation and commissioning at customer site
template.description: Delivery, installation, energisation and handover of a skid-mounted unit on a customer site. Covers work from arrival of the transport to signed handover. Does not cover civil works, permanent electrical supply beyond the local isolator, or operator training.

activities.name: Transport and offloading
activities.description: Receiving the unit on site and taking it off the vehicle with a mobile crane or forklift.

risks.event: Load shifts or falls while being lifted from the trailer
risks.cause: Lashings released before the crane takes the weight, or lifting points used that were only rated for transport restraint.
risks.consequence: Crush injury to personnel working alongside the trailer, and damage to the unit.
risks.minimumPpe: Hard hat, hi-vis, safety boots, impact gloves

risks.event: Person struck while guiding the load by hand
risks.cause: Banksman standing inside the swing radius to steady the unit instead of using a tagline.
risks.consequence: Crush or impact injury to hands and torso.
risks.minimumPpe: Hard hat, hi-vis, safety boots, impact gloves

activities.name: Positioning and mechanical installation
activities.description: Moving the unit onto its foundation, levelling it, and making the mechanical connections.

risks.event: Back or shoulder injury moving packaging and small components by hand
risks.cause: Repeated awkward lifts with no mechanical aid available at the working position.
risks.consequence: Musculoskeletal injury, potentially with lost time.

risks.event: Fingers trapped between the unit and its foundation frame
risks.cause: Hands used to align the skid while it is being lowered.

activities.name: Energisation and functional testing
activities.description: First energisation from the local isolator, then proving the control loops and safety functions.

risks.cause: Work carried out live because isolation was assumed rather than proven and locked off.
risks.consequence: Severe burns to the technician at the panel.
risks.minimumPpe: Arc-rated coverall, face shield, insulating gloves

risks.event: Unexpected movement of an actuator during loop testing
risks.cause: Stored pneumatic or hydraulic pressure not bled down before somebody reached inside the guard.
risks.consequence: Impact or crush injury to the person inside the guarded area.
risks.minimumPpe: Hard hat, safety boots, impact gloves

risks.event: Spill of hydraulic oil during first fill and pressure test
risks.cause: Connection not fully made up, or a test hose failing at pressure over unbunded ground.
risks.consequence: Contamination of surface water and the customer's drainage.

activities.name: Handover and documentation
activities.description: Completing the test record, handing over the as-built documentation, and demobilising.

risks.event: Unit handed over without a complete and signed test record
risks.cause: Commissioning finished under schedule pressure, with the record left to be completed later off site.
risks.consequence: No evidence the safety functions were proven; dispute over scope at final acceptance, and a return visit at our own cost.
